definition.en: A single vertex of creases in a flat sheet folds flat exactly when the alternating sum of the angles between consecutive creases is zero — equivalently, when every other angle adds up to 180°. Named after Toshikazu Kawasaki (also credited to Jacques Justin), it is the angle condition that complements Maekawa's count.
definition.es: Un vértice aislado de pliegues en un pliego plano se dobla en plano exactamente cuando la suma alternada de los ángulos entre pliegues consecutivos es cero; dicho de otro modo, cuando los ángulos tomados uno sí y uno no suman 180°. Lleva el nombre de Toshikazu Kawasaki (también se atribuye a Jacques Justin) y es la condición de ángulos que completa el conteo de Maekawa.
definition.fr: Un sommet isolé de plis dans une feuille plane se plie à plat exactement quand la somme alternée des angles entre plis consécutifs est nulle — autrement dit, quand un angle sur deux totalise 180°. Il porte le nom de Toshikazu Kawasaki (on l'attribue aussi à Jacques Justin) ; c'est la condition d'angles qui complète le décompte de Maekawa.
definition.pt: Um vértice isolado de vincos numa folha plana dobra-se em plano exatamente quando a soma alternada dos ângulos entre vincos consecutivos é zero — ou seja, quando os ângulos tomados alternadamente somam 180°. Tem o nome de Toshikazu Kawasaki (também é atribuído a Jacques Justin) e é a condição de ângulos que completa a contagem de Maekawa.

constraints: Test it exactly when the crease directions allow (rational slopes, exact arithmetic); a floating-point test needs a stated tolerance, or the verdict on a near-miss vertex depends on rounding rather than on the pattern.
sources: Thomas C. Hull, Origametry: Mathematical Methods in Paper Folding, Cambridge University Press, 2020
Erik D. Demaine and Joseph O'Rourke, Geometric Folding Algorithms: Linkages, Origami, Polyhedra, Cambridge University Press, 2007
